# Multi-Language Document

## JavaScript

```javascript
const greet = (name) => `Hello, ${name}!`;
```

## Python

```python
def greet(name):
    return f"Hello, {name}!"
```

## Ruby

```ruby
def greet(name)
  "Hello, #{name}!"
end
```

## Go

```go
func greet(name string) string {
    return fmt.Sprintf("Hello, %s!", name)
}
```

## Rust

```rust
fn greet(name: &str) -> String {
    format!("Hello, {}!", name)
}
```
